pairs.l: 1 — finds it crowded where they shop?
2 — can find going to stores stressful?
4 — likes to combine shopping with another activity?
5 — goes to shopping centres for social reasons?
6 — often buys things that they don't need?
9 — sometimes buys nothing when they go shopping?
10 — prefers to shop on their own?
11 — likes the appearance of where they shop?

r1.exp: 1=D (Diana: 'everywhere is so PACKED'). 2=F (Fran: 'I feel like I'm going to EXPLODE'). 3=C (Chris: 'I NEVER COME BACK WITHOUT PURCHASING SOMETHING TO WEAR'). 4=D (Diana: takes kids to CINEMA after shopping). 5=B (Bruno: loves cafés and bars in malls — 'HANG OUT'). 6=F (Fran: 'end up getting USELESS STUFF that wasn't even on the list'). 7=E (Ed: big stores 'hang around with masses of people in ENORMOUS QUEUES'). 8=B (Bruno: 'I CAN'T STAND THE STORES... I CAN'T BEAR ANY KIND OF STORE'). 9=A (Alex: 'Occasionally I DON'T EVEN GET ANYTHING'). 10=C (Chris: 'it should be a SOLITARY ACTIVITY without the distraction of friends'). 11=A (Alex: 'Everything's so SHINY AND ATTRACTIVE'). 12=E (Ed: 'I always have a LITTLE CHAT WITH THE OWNER... WE'VE KNOWN EACH OTHER FOR YEARS').

r13.exp: 'I was FASCINATED BY IT ALL... Everyone was really FRIENDLY TOO' = sjajna atmosfera = D.

r14.exp: 'The really TOUGH BIT was the PRACTICAL PART... when we had to go and WORK IN A KITCHEN' = radno iskustvo = B.

r15.exp: 'Italy's an amazing place. I WISH I HAD TRAVELLED ROUND MORE' = žali što nije vidio više zemlje = C.

r16.exp: 'Something on OUR NATIONAL CUISINE' = britanska kuhinja = A.

r17.exp: Ekipa snimala intervju o knjizi, ali slučajno uhvatila svađu — ideja za seriju nastala SLUČAJNO = A.

r18.exp: Adam: loš učenik, napustio školu, puno radio — TRUD VAŽNIJI OD KVALIFIKACIJA = D.

r19.exp: 'I screamed to get Stan out. (19)____. It WORKED. The fin turned and came towards ME.' → E: As THEY HEADED FOR HIM, I knew I had to DISTRACT THE SHARK, so I started SLAPPING THE WATER.

r20.exp: 'Everything below my knee was in the shark's mouth. (20)____. I thought about NOT BEING ABLE TO SAY GOODBYE TO MY PARENTS.' → H: I THOUGHT I WAS GOING TO DIE.

r21.exp: 'No time to reach me, only just picked up my brother. (21)____. By now I was dangling against the shark's body.' → B: I REMEMBER SEEING THEM SCREAMING BACK IN TOTAL PANIC.

r22.exp: 'It took me underwater, shaking me. (22)____. I'm not going down without a fight.' → F: AS I WENT DOWN, MY LUNGS FELT AS IF THEY WERE ON FIRE.

r23.exp: 'Suddenly, I was FREE. (23)____. The boat was nearer now, Stan saw me FLOATING IN THE WATER.' → D: I HAD BEEN DRAGGED ABOUT 50M UNDER WATER AND WHEN I BROKE THE SURFACE I WAS CLOSE TO BLACKING OUT.

r24.exp: 'I even thought about ending it all. (24)____. So I set my sights on making the NATIONAL SWIMMING TEAM.' → A: IT WAS MY BROTHER WHO SAID TO ME THAT I COULD ACHIEVE ANYTHING I WANTED.

r25.exp: 'Strategy to CLEAR your mind for new tasks' — fiksna kolokacija: clear your mind = osloboditi um.

r26.exp: 'Remember WHAT helps you to survive' — 'what' = ono što (nominalna relativna rečenica bez antecedenta).

r27.exp: 'Things you're KEEN ON' — fiksna prijedložna kolokacija: be keen on = biti oduševljen čime.

r28.exp: 'Something that's NEITHER good nor bad' — korelativna konstrukcija: neither... nor = niti... niti.

r29.exp: 'Literary facts or quotations' — 'literary' = književni (adjektiv za književnost/citate).

r30.exp: 'You will not remember them EASILY' — prilog 'easily' modificira glagol 'remember'.

r31.exp: 'It's no good TELLING yourself' — 'it's no good + -ing' (gerund nakon 'it's no good').

r32.exp: 'However strange that story may be' — 'however + adjective' za koncesiju = bez obzira koliko.

r33.exp: 'Melted BY intense heat' — prijedlog 'by' za uzrok u pasivnoj konstrukciji.

r34.exp: 'By SETTING fire to' — fiksna kolokacija: set fire to = zapaliti.

r35.exp: 'Succeeded IN fusing rocks' — fiksna prijedložna kolokacija: succeed in + gerund.

r36.exp: 'A mystery as WELL' — fiksni izraz: as well = također.

r37.exp: 'Stone rings WHOSE astronomical purpose is harder to explain' — posvojni relativni pronomen 'whose'.

r38.exp: 'People BETWEEN 15 and 25 years of age' — prijedlog 'between' za raspon.

r39.exp: 'Nobody has ever had TO' — modalni izraz: have to = morati (elipsa: had to [think about them]).

r40.exp: 'By WHOM ancient monuments were built' — upitno-relativno 'whom' za osobu (by whom = od koga).

sol.rubric: Esej 200-250 riječi. ZA turizom: ekonomski prihodi, radna mjesta, kulturna razmjena, infrastruktura. PROTIV: ekološka šteta, gubitak identiteta, gužve, skupi život za lokalne. Vlastito mišljenje.

w1.exp: Esej — ručno se ocjenjuje. Diskusijski esej. Viša razina: akademski stil, 200–250 riječi.
